name: Voice Companion (Jarvis mode)
author: hearth-team
description: Realtime voice conversation with your agent—speak to an animated avatar, powered by OpenAI Realtime. Tool calls route through your existing skills. Daily usage cap, push-to-talk default, and approvals rail for safety. The voice lane that keeps data on your machine (local WebRTC to OpenAI, no audio relay through Hearth).

vault_inputs.label: Voice
vault_inputs.help: Which voice the agent uses to speak to you. All OpenAI Realtime voices; preview at https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/realtime. Default: marin.

vault_inputs.label: Microphone mode
vault_inputs.help: Push-to-talk (PTT) is the default — lower cost and privacy. Voice activity detection (VAD) is opt-in and more expensive. Choose based on your preference.

vault_inputs.label: Daily usage cap (minutes)
vault_inputs.help: Maximum total duration of voice sessions per calendar day. Realtime is expensive (~$0.30-0.60/min); default 30 min/day enforces containment. Adjust based on your comfort with cost.

vault_inputs.label: Avatar style

options.label: Orb (stylized sphere with eyes and mouth)
Iron Man (mask with lip sync + moods)

vault_inputs.help: Which 3D avatar renders in the voice interface. Orb is a detailed face; floppy is a retro prop that animates via transform rather than facial rigs; Iron Man is a full face-mode mask (lip sync, blink, moods). Default: orb.
